integrity: The analytic argument is primary. Finite numerical checks are consistency evidence only. The stated constants correspond to the non-halved Hellinger square with circle length measure.
scientific_limitations: Known fixed shape and scale; location translations only. The central singular case alpha=1, joint nuisance-parameter inference and minimax estimation rates are not addressed. A residual risk remains that an older, differently worded translation/Hellinger theorem covers the special model.
title: A sharp location-information transition for wrapped Linnik laws
